value.rationale: Source-sink covariance is a natural joint statistic under random edge orientation. The result classifies the effect of subdividing any edge by its two endpoint degrees with a sharp, universal threshold at degree four, then shows a topology-independent reversal for every r-regular graph with r>=4. This is a motivated structural boundary, not a marginal numerical improvement or restatement of an enumerator.
